# Raspberry Pi Foundation

> > The Raspberry Pi Foundation is a UK charity providing free computing education resources, curricula, and programs to teach young people and educators coding, AI, and digital skills worldwide.

The Raspberry Pi Foundation operates globally to democratize access to computing education through free resources, teacher training, and research-backed curricula. The organization combines physical computing products with comprehensive educational programs spanning Python, AI/machine learning, and computer science for ages 5-16.

## Learning & Education

- [Learn to code](https://www.raspberrypi.org/learn): Free coding learning resources and challenges for kids and teens
- [Free Online Courses](https://www.raspberrypi.org/courses): Free online Python and programming courses for beginners
- [The Computing Curriculum](https://www.raspberrypi.org/curriculum): Free comprehensive computing curriculum for ages 5-16 across multiple countries
- [AI education](https://www.raspberrypi.org/teach/ai-education): Free AI and machine learning education resources for teachers and students

## Teaching & Professional Development

- [Teaching resources](https://www.raspberrypi.org/teach): Computer science teaching resources and CPD courses for educators
- [Hello World](https://www.raspberrypi.org/hello-world): Free magazine, podcasts and lesson plans for computing educators
- [About us](https://www.raspberrypi.org/about): About page describing Raspberry Pi Foundation mission and organization

## Research & Impact

- [Research & impact](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact): Research and impact evaluation in computing education with University of Cambridge
- [Impact reports](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/impact): Impact reports and evidence of educational outcomes from Foundation programs
- [Computing education research seminars](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/research/seminars): Free online seminars featuring world-leading computing education researchers
- [Research projects](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/research/projects): Computing education research projects across UK, Ghana, and India
- [Research publications](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/research/publications): Open access computing education research publications and papers

## Products & Community

- [Computers](https://www.raspberrypi.org/computers): Raspberry Pi computer products and physical computing resources
- [Blog](https://www.raspberrypi.org/blog): Official blog with news, stories, and announcements about computing education
- [Community stories](https://www.raspberrypi.org/community-stories): Stories from young digital makers and educators using technology

## Support & Get Involved

- [Support us](https://www.raspberrypi.org/support-us): Donation, partnership, and volunteer opportunities to support the Foundation
- [Donate](https://www.raspberrypi.org/donate): Donation page for supporting youth computing education programs
